verdict.rationale: Typesense is a headless search server. It documents dedicated guides for running tests with Testcontainers and in GitHub Actions, and it ships Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Linux binary and Terraform deployment options, so it fits automated and CI pipelines. A community user also reports running it in docker compose. Missing for 10: detailed CI guide content beyond section headings, documentation of the referenced official CLI's automation use, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
